name: @chartcoach/brand
description: Shared brand assets, CSS tokens, and public asset checks for chartcoach web apps.

scripts.build: pnpm run check:assets && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.sync:assets: pnpm run render:svg && pnpm run render:png && node scripts/sync-public-assets.mjs
scripts.check:assets: pnpm run render:svg -- --check && pnpm run render:png -- --check && node scripts/check-public-assets.mjs
